title.narrative: GESTA: Gobernanza, Economía, Sociedad civil, Territorio, Autonomía

description.narrative: Based on previous experience, it is proposed to amplify the relevant initiatives in the next three years, with the aim of promoting indigenous and peasant civil society in the Amazon and Chaco regions, with women and youth playing a leading role, and with an inter-territorial approach, to improve governance, territorial economy and sustainability. In practical terms, actions have been planned to support economic initiatives, training in financial management and family and community economic administration, strengthen organizations, articulate inter-territorial initiatives, and auscultate cross-border processes, in the territorial dimension it is planned to interact with 2,821 rights holders (1,891 women and 930 men), who belong to 16 indigenous peasant communities in two strategic regions of the Amazon. At the same time, the institutional capacities of the institution and alliances with other partners are strengthened to amplify and strengthen the dimensions of public and political advocacy through the axes of research, communication, interlearning and territorial development.
